user_query: I'm planning a trip to Senegal and need directions from the airport in Dakar to the nearest hospital, along with the time zone of Senegal.

TaskList.description: Get the geographical location of the airport in Dakar.
Find the nearest hospital to the airport in Dakar based on the location obtained in step 1.
Retrieve directions from the airport to the nearest hospital using the locations obtained in steps 1 and 2.
Get the time zone information for Senegal.
